output_prompt.type: all-in-one character model sheet (turnaround + alt-worlds + expression grid + pixel art)
output_prompt.en:
Create ONE cohesive high-resolution character model sheet for the CryptoNinja character "Jin", on a clean light-grey background, divided into 5 horizontal bands. Character identity, face, colors and equipment must stay perfectly consistent in every panel.

IDENTITY (absolute reference): male master ninja, full black/navy shinobi outfit, hood covering most of face, headband with three diamond motifs, sharp angular eyes, cloth mask, chainmail-mesh chest and wrists, grey vambraces, large shuriken, gold-hilted katana on back, fire (Katon) energy. IGA clan. If a reference image is attached, it OVERRIDES this text — match its face, hair, colors and equipment exactly.

TEXT RULES: render ONLY the caption strings listed below, in clean bold sans-serif capitals. Do not invent, alter or add any other text, letters or logos anywhere.

HEADER (top of sheet): "CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: JIN" and smaller "CRYPTONINJA — IGA CLAN".

ROW 1 — caption "CHIBI TURNAROUND": the character in chibi 2-head-tall super-deformed style with thick bold black outlines and flat slightly muted colors (CryptoNinja NFT art style), full body, neutral A-pose, exactly 3 views left-to-right labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK".

ROW 2 — caption "FULL-BODY TURNAROUND": the SAME character redrawn CLEARLY TALLER at a normal 7-to-8-head-tall anime body ratio — long slender limbs, adult-like proportions, absolutely NOT chibi, visibly taller and more realistic than Row 1 — exactly 3 views labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK", clean anime lineart with detailed cel-shading, polished modern anime-illustration quality.

ROW 3 — caption "ALT-WORLD VARIANTS": three labeled panels left-to-right, each containing the character redesigned full-body, shown twice (chibi version + normal-proportion version side by side): panel "FANTASY": Medieval-fantasy world, enchanted armor and robes, magical glowing effects, castle or mystical forest background. panel "SCI-FI": Futuristic augmentations, neon-lit high-tech armor, holographic ninjutsu effects, dystopian megacity background. panel "MODERN": Setting swapped to contemporary city — streetwear/techwear version of the outfit, urban neon background, smartphone-era vibe.

ROW 4 — caption "EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS": a strict table of bust-up expression portraits in RECTANGULAR bordered cells with dark-navy cell backgrounds, edge-to-edge like a game expression sheet. EXACTLY 4 rows and EXACTLY 8 columns = 32 cells total. Row labels top-to-bottom: "BASE", "FANTASY", "SCI-FI", "MODERN" (the outfit of that world, same face). Column labels left-to-right: "NEUTRAL" / "SMILE" / "ANGRY" / "SAD" / "SURPRISED" / "SHY" / "DETERMINED" / "LAUGH". Fill every cell — no empty cells, no merged cells, no circular frames.

ROW 5 — caption "PIXEL ART / DOT-E": retro pixel-art sprites on a transparent-look checkerboard, in TWO labeled groups side by side, "32x32" (chunky) and "48x48" (detailed). Each group contains: idle full-body sprites in 3 views (front/side/back) on one line, a walking animation as ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY 4 equal frames on the next line, and 4 tiny pixel face icons on the last line. Keep the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) readable even at low resolution.

REQUIREMENTS: the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) consistent everywhere; no watermark; no cropping of any figure at panel edges; no duplicate or missing views; even lighting; small clean captions exactly as specified. The sheet must be usable as a production reference for anime, manga and 2D/pixel games.

SHEET LAYOUT: portrait 4:5. Top-to-bottom: HEADER → ROW 1 → ROW 2 → ROW 3 → ROW 4 → ROW 5, each band with a small dark label tab at its top-left. Even margins and consistent gutters.
output_prompt.jp:
CryptoNinjaのキャラ「Jin」のキャラクターモデルシートを高解像度1枚に生成。薄いグレー地を5つの横帯に分割。全パネルで顔・配色・装備・アイデンティティを完全統一。

アイデンティティ（絶対基準）：漆黒の忍装束、三菱形の額あて、鋭い目、大手裏剣、金柄の刀、炎術。参照画像が添付されている場合はそちらを最優先し、顔・髪・配色・装備を完全一致させる。

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

ヘッダー：「CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: JIN」と小さく「CRYPTONINJA — IGA CLAN」。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

要件：特徴を全所で統一。透かし禁止。パネル端で人物を見切らせない。ビューの重複・欠落禁止。均一な光。キャプションは指定文字列のみ。アニメ・漫画・2Dゲーム制作に使える設定資料として成立させる。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。

output_prompt.en:
Create ONE cohesive high-resolution character model sheet for the CryptoNinja character "Oto", on a clean light-grey background, divided into 5 horizontal bands. Character identity, face, colors and equipment must stay perfectly consistent in every panel.

IDENTITY (absolute reference): cheerful female ninja with pink rabbit ears (white inner ears with black markings), short pink bob with blunt bangs, golden sparkle stars in her eyes, wide happy open-mouth smile, blushing cheeks, green headband tied at the back, pink kimono-style shinobi wrap top with a small rabbit emblem on the chest, magenta sash tied in a bow, fluffy rabbit tail, diamond-pattern-scabbard katana on back, holding a green sake bottle/flask with a label, black thigh-high socks, talkative lively personality, summoning (Kuchiyose) of rabbits. KOKA clan. If a reference image is attached, it OVERRIDES this text — match its face, hair, colors and equipment exactly.

TEXT RULES: render ONLY the caption strings listed below, in clean bold sans-serif capitals. Do not invent, alter or add any other text, letters or logos anywhere.

HEADER (top of sheet): "CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: OTO" and smaller "CRYPTONINJA — KOKA CLAN".

ROW 1 — caption "CHIBI TURNAROUND": the character in chibi 2-head-tall super-deformed style with thick bold black outlines and flat slightly muted colors (CryptoNinja NFT art style), full body, neutral A-pose, exactly 3 views left-to-right labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK".

ROW 2 — caption "FULL-BODY TURNAROUND": the SAME character redrawn CLEARLY TALLER at a normal 7-to-8-head-tall anime body ratio — long slender limbs, adult-like proportions, absolutely NOT chibi, visibly taller and more realistic than Row 1 — exactly 3 views labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK", clean anime lineart with detailed cel-shading, polished modern anime-illustration quality.

ROW 3 — caption "ALT-WORLD VARIANTS": three labeled panels left-to-right, each containing the character redesigned full-body, shown twice (chibi version + normal-proportion version side by side): panel "FANTASY": Medieval-fantasy world, enchanted armor and robes, magical glowing effects, castle or mystical forest background. panel "SCI-FI": Futuristic augmentations, neon-lit high-tech armor, holographic ninjutsu effects, dystopian megacity background. panel "MODERN": Setting swapped to contemporary city — streetwear/techwear version of the outfit, urban neon background, smartphone-era vibe.

ROW 4 — caption "EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS": a strict table of bust-up expression portraits in RECTANGULAR bordered cells with dark-navy cell backgrounds, edge-to-edge like a game expression sheet. EXACTLY 4 rows and EXACTLY 8 columns = 32 cells total. Row labels top-to-bottom: "BASE", "FANTASY", "SCI-FI", "MODERN" (the outfit of that world, same face). Column labels left-to-right: "NEUTRAL" / "SMILE" / "ANGRY" / "SAD" / "SURPRISED" / "SHY" / "DETERMINED" / "LAUGH". Fill every cell — no empty cells, no merged cells, no circular frames.

ROW 5 — caption "PIXEL ART / DOT-E": retro pixel-art sprites on a transparent-look checkerboard, in TWO labeled groups side by side, "32x32" (chunky) and "48x48" (detailed). Each group contains: idle full-body sprites in 3 views (front/side/back) on one line, a walking animation as ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY 4 equal frames on the next line, and 4 tiny pixel face icons on the last line. Keep the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) readable even at low resolution.

REQUIREMENTS: the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) consistent everywhere; no watermark; no cropping of any figure at panel edges; no duplicate or missing views; even lighting; small clean captions exactly as specified. The sheet must be usable as a production reference for anime, manga and 2D/pixel games.

SHEET LAYOUT: portrait 4:5. Top-to-bottom: HEADER → ROW 1 → ROW 2 → ROW 3 → ROW 4 → ROW 5, each band with a small dark label tab at its top-left. Even margins and consistent gutters.

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

要件：特徴を全所で統一。透かし禁止。パネル端で人物を見切らせない。ビューの重複・欠落禁止。均一な光。キャプションは指定文字列のみ。アニメ・漫画・2Dゲーム制作に使える設定資料として成立させる。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。

output_prompt.type: all-in-one character model sheet (turnaround + alt-worlds + expression grid + pixel art)
output_prompt.en:
Create ONE cohesive high-resolution character model sheet for the CryptoNinja character "Nagisa", on a clean light-grey background, divided into 5 horizontal bands. Character identity, face, colors and equipment must stay perfectly consistent in every panel.

IDENTITY (absolute reference): shy gentle female ninja, shadow-clone (Kagebunshin) illusions, scroll, caring demeanor. SAIKA clan. If a reference image is attached, it OVERRIDES this text — match its face, hair, colors and equipment exactly.

TEXT RULES: render ONLY the caption strings listed below, in clean bold sans-serif capitals. Do not invent, alter or add any other text, letters or logos anywhere.

HEADER (top of sheet): "CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: NAGISA" and smaller "CRYPTONINJA — SAIKA CLAN".

ROW 1 — caption "CHIBI TURNAROUND": the character in chibi 2-head-tall super-deformed style with thick bold black outlines and flat slightly muted colors (CryptoNinja NFT art style), full body, neutral A-pose, exactly 3 views left-to-right labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK".

ROW 2 — caption "FULL-BODY TURNAROUND": the SAME character redrawn CLEARLY TALLER at a normal 7-to-8-head-tall anime body ratio — long slender limbs, adult-like proportions, absolutely NOT chibi, visibly taller and more realistic than Row 1 — exactly 3 views labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK", clean anime lineart with detailed cel-shading, polished modern anime-illustration quality.

ROW 3 — caption "ALT-WORLD VARIANTS": three labeled panels left-to-right, each containing the character redesigned full-body, shown twice (chibi version + normal-proportion version side by side): panel "FANTASY": Medieval-fantasy world, enchanted armor and robes, magical glowing effects, castle or mystical forest background. panel "SCI-FI": Futuristic augmentations, neon-lit high-tech armor, holographic ninjutsu effects, dystopian megacity background. panel "MODERN": Setting swapped to contemporary city — streetwear/techwear version of the outfit, urban neon background, smartphone-era vibe.

ROW 4 — caption "EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS": a strict table of bust-up expression portraits in RECTANGULAR bordered cells with dark-navy cell backgrounds, edge-to-edge like a game expression sheet. EXACTLY 4 rows and EXACTLY 8 columns = 32 cells total. Row labels top-to-bottom: "BASE", "FANTASY", "SCI-FI", "MODERN" (the outfit of that world, same face). Column labels left-to-right: "NEUTRAL" / "SMILE" / "ANGRY" / "SAD" / "SURPRISED" / "SHY" / "DETERMINED" / "LAUGH". Fill every cell — no empty cells, no merged cells, no circular frames.

ROW 5 — caption "PIXEL ART / DOT-E": retro pixel-art sprites on a transparent-look checkerboard, in TWO labeled groups side by side, "32x32" (chunky) and "48x48" (detailed). Each group contains: idle full-body sprites in 3 views (front/side/back) on one line, a walking animation as ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY 4 equal frames on the next line, and 4 tiny pixel face icons on the last line. Keep the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) readable even at low resolution.

REQUIREMENTS: the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) consistent everywhere; no watermark; no cropping of any figure at panel edges; no duplicate or missing views; even lighting; small clean captions exactly as specified. The sheet must be usable as a production reference for anime, manga and 2D/pixel games.

SHEET LAYOUT: portrait 4:5. Top-to-bottom: HEADER → ROW 1 → ROW 2 → ROW 3 → ROW 4 → ROW 5, each band with a small dark label tab at its top-left. Even margins and consistent gutters.
output_prompt.jp:
CryptoNinjaのキャラ「Nagisa」のキャラクターモデルシートを高解像度1枚に生成。薄いグレー地を5つの横帯に分割。全パネルで顔・配色・装備・アイデンティティを完全統一。

アイデンティティ（絶対基準）：内気で優しい少女忍者、影分身、巻物。参照画像が添付されている場合はそちらを最優先し、顔・髪・配色・装備を完全一致させる。

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

ヘッダー：「CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: NAGISA」と小さく「CRYPTONINJA — SAIKA CLAN」。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

要件：特徴を全所で統一。透かし禁止。パネル端で人物を見切らせない。ビューの重複・欠落禁止。均一な光。キャプションは指定文字列のみ。アニメ・漫画・2Dゲーム制作に使える設定資料として成立させる。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。

CryptoNinjaのキャラ「Sattva」のキャラクターモデルシートを高解像度1枚に生成。薄いグレー地を5つの横帯に分割。全パネルで顔・配色・装備・アイデンティティを完全統一。

アイデンティティ（絶対基準）：天界の存在、涅槃、光の輪、天上的。参照画像が添付されている場合はそちらを最優先し、顔・髪・配色・装備を完全一致させる。

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

ヘッダー：「CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: SATTVA」と小さく「CRYPTONINJA — HEAVENLY REALM CLAN」。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

要件：特徴を全所で統一。透かし禁止。パネル端で人物を見切らせない。ビューの重複・欠落禁止。均一な光。キャプションは指定文字列のみ。アニメ・漫画・2Dゲーム制作に使える設定資料として成立させる。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。

ROW 4 — caption "EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS": a strict table of bust-up expression portraits in RECTANGULAR bordered cells with dark-navy cell backgrounds, edge-to-edge like a game expression sheet. Each group contains: idle full-body sprites in 3 views (front/side/back) on one line, a walking animation as ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY 4 equal frames on the next line, and 4 tiny pixel face icons on the last line. アイデンティティ（絶対基準）：翼を持つ静かな守り手、雷遁、山奥。参照画像が添付されている場合はそちらを最優先し、顔・髪・配色・装備を完全一致させる。

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

ヘッダー：「CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: KARURA」と小さく「CRYPTONINJA — IGA CLAN」。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。

output_prompt.en:
Professional game character reference sheet designed for AUTOMATED CROPPING, portrait orientation 2:3, light gray background.

STRICT GRID LAYOUT RULE: The entire page is divided into 6 horizontal section rows of fixed heights, top to bottom: Row1 15%, Row2 20%, Row3 20%, Row4 15%, Row5 18%, Row6 12%. Every section row is enclosed in a visible thin dark-navy rectangular border frame with a dark-navy label bar at its top-left. Inside each row, content is placed in EQUAL-WIDTH CELLS separated by visible thin navy grid lines. Every character or icon is FULLY CONTAINED inside its own cell, centered, never touching or overlapping the cell borders, with uniform 5% padding inside each cell. Same margins everywhere. No elements outside frames.

CHARACTER: A young ghost-spirit girl (zashiki-warashi yokai), pale blue bob hair, red eyes, small fang, white kimono with pink hem, purple obi sash with large back bow, black headband crown holding three lit white candles, small wooden mallet, tiny floating white grumpy ghost companion. Anime chibi style, bold clean outlines, soft cel shading.

ROW 1 — "CHIBI TURNAROUND": 3 equal cells: chibi front view / chibi front smiling / chibi back view. Each chibi centered in its cell at identical scale, feet on the same baseline.

ROW 2 — "FULL-BODY TURNAROUND": 3 equal cells: full-body front / side / back, normal proportions, identical scale, feet on the same baseline.

ROW 3 — "ALT-WORLD VARIANTS": 3 equal cells: (a) FANTASY miko outfit with red hakama, golden flame crown, ornate staff; (b) SCI-FI cyberpunk bodysuit with glowing cyan/purple circuits, holographic blue flames; (c) MODERN streetwear, lavender hoodie, black cargo pants, LED headband, smartphone. One chibi + one full-body pair per cell, both fully inside the cell.

ROW 4 — "GAME EXPRESSION SPRITES": a 4-column x 2-row grid of 8 equal square cells, each cell a FLAT SOLID dark-navy (#1a2244) background with a thin border. One bust-up portrait per cell, chest-up, identical camera angle, identical head size and identical head position in every cell (eyes on the same horizontal line across all 8 cells). Expressions in fixed order, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) neutral smile, (2) happy grin with fang, (3) eyes-closed laugh, (4) angry puffed cheeks, (5) sad teary eyes, (6) surprised with sweat drop, (7) embarrassed blush, (8) smug smirk. Visual-novel portrait quality.

ROW 5 — "GAG MANGA STYLE": exactly 3 equal manga panels side by side, each with a thick black rectangular panel border, BLACK AND WHITE monochrome manga: bold ink lines, screentones, speed lines. Panel 1: girl proudly posing with mallet. Panel 2: shocked wavy-body Munch-scream gag face. Panel 3: ghost companion deadpan retort. Empty speech bubbles fully inside each panel.

ROW 6 — "PIXEL ART / DOT-E": 2 equal cells on transparent checkerboard: left cell 32x32 sprites (4-direction walk + 2 face icons in a neat row), right cell 48x48 sprites (same set). Sprites aligned on a single baseline, evenly spaced.

Consistent character design across all rows, same face and hair everywhere, clean technical model-sheet presentation, high detail.

自動切り出しを前提としたプロのゲーム用キャラクター設定資料、縦長2:3、ライトグレー背景。

厳格グリッドレイアウト規則:ページ全体を上から高さ比率固定の6つの横長セクション行に分割(行1=15%、行2=20%、行3=20%、行4=15%、行5=18%、行6=12%)。各行は細い濃紺の長方形枠線で囲み、左上に濃紺のラベルバーを付ける。行の内部は等幅のセルに分割し、細い濃紺の区切り線を表示する。すべてのキャラクター・アイコンは自分のセルの内側に完全に収め、中央配置、枠線に触れたりはみ出したりしない。各セル内側に5%の均一な余白。枠の外に要素を置かない。

キャラクター:座敷童子の幽霊少女。水色ボブヘア、赤い瞳、八重歯、白い着物(裾ピンク)、紫の帯と大きな背中リボン、頭に3本の火のついた白ロウソクの黒い冠、小さな木槌、不機嫌顔の白い小さなお化けのお供。アニメちび調、太い主線、セルルック陰影。

行1「チビ三面図」:等幅3セル(正面/正面笑顔/背面)。各ちびはセル中央・同一スケール・足元は同じ基準線上。

行2「全身三面図」:等幅3セル(正面/側面/背面)、通常頭身、同一スケール、足元の基準線を揃える。

行3「世界観バリエーション」:等幅3セル:(a)ファンタジー=巫女・緋袴・炎の黄金宝冠・装飾杖 (b)SF=シアン&紫の回路が光るサイバースーツ・ホログラム青蝋燭 (c)現代=ストリート系・ラベンダーパーカー・黒カーゴ・LEDヘッドバンド・スマホ。各セルにちび+全身のペアを完全に収める。

行4「ゲーム用表情スプライト」:横4×縦2の等サイズ正方形セル8個。各セルは完全単色の濃紺(#1a2244)背景+細枠線。1セルに1つのバストアップ、胸から上、全セルでカメラアングル・頭のサイズ・頭の位置を完全一致(8セルすべてで目の高さを同じ水平線上に揃える)。表情は左→右、上段→下段の固定順:①微笑み ②八重歯の笑顔 ③目を閉じた笑い ④頬を膨らませた怒り ⑤涙目 ⑥汗マークの驚き ⑦照れ赤面 ⑧ドヤ顔ニヤリ。ノベルゲーム立ち絵品質。

行5「ギャグ漫画スタイル」:太い黒枠のコマを横にちょうど3つ等幅で並べる。白黒モノクロ漫画:太いペン線、スクリーントーン、集中線。コマ1=木槌でドヤ顔の見得。コマ2=白目&ぐにゃぐにゃのムンクの叫び風ギャグ顔。コマ3=お化けの真顔ツッコミ。吹き出しはコマ内に完全に収める。

行6「ドット絵」:透過チェッカー背景の等幅2セル:左=32x32(4方向歩行+顔アイコン2種を一列に)、右=48x48(同セット)。スプライトは1本の基準線に揃え、等間隔配置。

全行でキャラクターデザイン完全統一、清潔なテクニカル設定画レイアウト、高精細。

output_prompt.type: all-in-one character model sheet (turnaround + alt-worlds + expression grid + pixel art)
output_prompt.en:
Create ONE cohesive high-resolution character model sheet for the CryptoNinja character "Quon", on a clean light-grey background, divided into 5 horizontal bands. Character identity, face, colors and equipment must stay perfectly consistent in every panel.

IDENTITY (absolute reference): ageless enigmatic male ninja calling himself 'washi', cat's-eye future-choosing power, floating onibi flames. SAIKA clan. If a reference image is attached, it OVERRIDES this text — match its face, hair, colors and equipment exactly.

TEXT RULES: render ONLY the caption strings listed below, in clean bold sans-serif capitals. Do not invent, alter or add any other text, letters or logos anywhere.

HEADER (top of sheet): "CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: QUON" and smaller "CRYPTONINJA — SAIKA CLAN".

ROW 1 — caption "CHIBI TURNAROUND": the character in chibi 2-head-tall super-deformed style with thick bold black outlines and flat slightly muted colors (CryptoNinja NFT art style), full body, neutral A-pose, exactly 3 views left-to-right labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK".

ROW 2 — caption "FULL-BODY TURNAROUND": the SAME character redrawn CLEARLY TALLER at a normal 7-to-8-head-tall anime body ratio — long slender limbs, adult-like proportions, absolutely NOT chibi, visibly taller and more realistic than Row 1 — exactly 3 views labeled "FRONT" / "SIDE" / "BACK", clean anime lineart with detailed cel-shading, polished modern anime-illustration quality.

ROW 3 — caption "ALT-WORLD VARIANTS": three labeled panels left-to-right, each containing the character redesigned full-body, shown twice (chibi version + normal-proportion version side by side): panel "FANTASY": Medieval-fantasy world, enchanted armor and robes, magical glowing effects, castle or mystical forest background. panel "SCI-FI": Futuristic augmentations, neon-lit high-tech armor, holographic ninjutsu effects, dystopian megacity background. panel "MODERN": Setting swapped to contemporary city — streetwear/techwear version of the outfit, urban neon background, smartphone-era vibe.

ROW 4 — caption "EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS": a strict table of bust-up expression portraits in RECTANGULAR bordered cells with dark-navy cell backgrounds, edge-to-edge like a game expression sheet. EXACTLY 4 rows and EXACTLY 8 columns = 32 cells total. Row labels top-to-bottom: "BASE", "FANTASY", "SCI-FI", "MODERN" (the outfit of that world, same face). Column labels left-to-right: "NEUTRAL" / "SMILE" / "ANGRY" / "SAD" / "SURPRISED" / "SHY" / "DETERMINED" / "LAUGH". Fill every cell — no empty cells, no merged cells, no circular frames.

ROW 5 — caption "PIXEL ART / DOT-E": retro pixel-art sprites on a transparent-look checkerboard, in TWO labeled groups side by side, "32x32" (chunky) and "48x48" (detailed). Each group contains: idle full-body sprites in 3 views (front/side/back) on one line, a walking animation as ONE horizontal strip of EXACTLY 4 equal frames on the next line, and 4 tiny pixel face icons on the last line. Keep the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) readable even at low resolution.

REQUIREMENTS: the character's signature features (hair color, eye color, headwear, outfit colors, weapon) consistent everywhere; no watermark; no cropping of any figure at panel edges; no duplicate or missing views; even lighting; small clean captions exactly as specified. The sheet must be usable as a production reference for anime, manga and 2D/pixel games.

SHEET LAYOUT: portrait 4:5. Top-to-bottom: HEADER → ROW 1 → ROW 2 → ROW 3 → ROW 4 → ROW 5, each band with a small dark label tab at its top-left. Even margins and consistent gutters.
output_prompt.jp:
CryptoNinjaのキャラ「Quon」のキャラクターモデルシートを高解像度1枚に生成。薄いグレー地を5つの横帯に分割。全パネルで顔・配色・装備・アイデンティティを完全統一。

アイデンティティ（絶対基準）：己を『わし』と呼ぶ不老の忍、猫目の未来選択、浮遊する鬼火。参照画像が添付されている場合はそちらを最優先し、顔・髪・配色・装備を完全一致させる。

文字ルール：下記に列挙したキャプション文字列のみを太字サンセリフの大文字で描く。それ以外の文字・ロゴ・記号は一切描かない。

ヘッダー：「CHARACTER MODEL SHEET: QUON」と小さく「CRYPTONINJA — SAIKA CLAN」。

1行目「CHIBI TURNAROUND」…クリプト忍者NFT調の2頭身ちび（太い黒線・フラット配色）、全身Aポーズ、左から FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー。

2行目「FULL-BODY TURNAROUND」…同キャラを明確に背の高い7〜8頭身のアニメ体型で描き直す（手足は細長く大人びた比率、ちび絶対禁止、1行目より明らかに高身長で写実寄り）。FRONT / SIDE / BACK のちょうど3ビュー、丁寧なセル塗りのクリーンなアニメ線画。

3行目「ALT-WORLD VARIANTS」…FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN の3パネル。各パネルにちび版と通常頭身版を並べて全身で描く。内容は各画風プロンプト（fantasy/scifi/modern）に従う。

4行目「EXPRESSION ICONS x WORLDS」…角枠セル（濃紺背景）を敷き詰めた厳密な表。ちょうど4行×8列=32セル。行ラベルは上から BASE / FANTASY / SCI-FI / MODERN（世界観の衣装違い・顔は同一）。列ラベルは左から NEUTRAL / SMILE / ANGRY / SAD / SURPRISED / SHY / DETERMINED / LAUGH。空セル・結合セル・丸枠は禁止。

5行目「PIXEL ART / DOT-E」…透過風チェッカー地のドット絵。「32x32」と「48x48」の2グループを横並び。各グループ：待機3面（正/側/背）を1段目、歩行アニメはちょうど4コマの横帯を2段目、表情アイコン4種を3段目。低解像度でも特徴が判別できること。

要件：特徴を全所で統一。透かし禁止。パネル端で人物を見切らせない。ビューの重複・欠落禁止。均一な光。キャプションは指定文字列のみ。アニメ・漫画・2Dゲーム制作に使える設定資料として成立させる。

配置：縦4:5。上から ヘッダー→1行目→2行目→3行目→4行目→5行目。各帯の左上に小さな濃色ラベルタブ。余白・間隔は均一。
